notes.title: Official Version Ver1.00.00 Released!
notes.notes:
Official Version Ver1.00.00 Released
Here are the patch notes:


Official Version Ver1.00.00 Released
Here are the patch notes:

[New Stage Addition]

・Added the final chapter "The Dream Labyrinth" .
・Added new enemies, weapons, and achievements.


[New Skills Added]

・Several new skills have been added.
All skills will be detailed on a separate page.


[Unit "+" Value Added]

Units will now gain a "+" value next to their name when they reach a certain level. The higher the "+" value, the greater the growth in HP, attack, and defense. These "+" values can be carried over even through job changes or inheritance.


[New Features]

・An auto-activation function for selected leader skills has been added.
・A relic reroll feature has been added.
These features can be unlocked in the unlock screen, allowing for use in-game and an increase in the number of uses.


[New Relics Added]

・A relic that activates when enemies step on traps.
・A relic that reduces the number of enemies that appear.
・A relic that increases the first attack in battle.
Several other new relics have been added.

[Relic Balance Adjustments]

・Some relics now require obtaining prerequisite relics before they can be acquired.


[Game Balance Adjustments]

・Added a level-up limit per battle/training session.
・Increased the experience required for advanced classes.
・Increased the recovery rate of units that did not participate in battle to 15%.
・Adjusted the stats of some enemies from Chapters 1 to 3.
・Adjusted the event timing for "Corrupt Wave".
・Adjusted the duration of combined status effects to match the longest status effect.
・Adjusted the cost for unlocking the inventory limit of inheritance units and weapons.


[Visual Adjustments]

・Facilities now blink when their effects are activated.
・Skill icon adjustments.
・Adjustments to certain UI elements.


[Other Adjustments]

・Adjusted camera movement values.
・Adjusted the ADV part text in Chapter 2.
・Added a tutorial.
・Other minor text corrections, bug fixes, and overall polish.

notes.title: Regarding the Official Release
notes.notes:
We will be updating with the official release, including the final chapter, on Saturday, October 19th. Below is a selection of the new features and adjustments that will be implemented.


[New Stage Addition]
The Final chapter, " The Dream Labyrinth" , will be added, concluding the story. Along with it, new enemies, weapons, and achievements will be introduced.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/223a774620790770f0b8dc7c498ae5c7f8d8ce0d.png


[Addition of Unit "+" Values]
Units can now gain a "+" value next to their name by reaching a certain level. The higher the "+" value, the greater the growth bonuses for HP, attack power, and defense. These "+" values can be carried over even through job changes or inheritance.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/d3c61a53bdcb1e56a24dfb24ce6434a93687b8c2.png


[New Skill Additions]
・Assassin
JPS:Attacking Tactics___ATK and DEF increases by 5% with each attack until the end of the battle.Activates only when in Assassin class

・Warlock
JPS:White Night's Wrath___Gain 50％ ATK for each damage received until the end of the battle Activates only when in Warlock class

Several additional new skills and adjustments to existing skills will be made. 


[New Features]
・An auto-activation feature for leader skills has been added, allowing selected leader skills to be used automatically.
・A feature for rerolling relics has been added.
These functions will be added to the unlock screen, and you can unlock them to use them in-game or increase the number of times they can be used.


[New Relics Added]

・A relic that activates when enemies step on a trap.
・A relic that reduces the number of enemies that appear.
・A relic that increases the power of the first attack in battle.
Several other new relics have also been added.


[Game Balance Adjustments]
・The experience required for leveling up advanced jobs has increased, and a limit of 3 levels per battle or training session has been set.
・The recovery rate for units that did not participate in battle has been increased from 10% to 15%.
・The cost for unlocking the unit and weapon inventory limit has been adjusted.

【Chapter 4: New Stage Added】

The following skills have been added:

 Swordsman

 Adjusted existing units and skills.
 In Chapter 1, enemy reinforcement panels no longer appear; instead, damage panels will appear.


【Other Adjustments】

 Adjusted the appearance of some weapons.
 Corrected typos, fixed bugs, and improved UX.

notes.title: [Ver 0.03.21]Patch Notes
notes.notes:
I have updated the following items:

New Implementations:


 Plaza Panel Implementation: Plaza panels where units can be placed will be randomly placed. Plaza panels allow unit placement even in unexplored areas if they are shallower than the current maximum depth. While generally safe zones, if adjacent panels are open as squares, enemies may invade. Additionally, they will be attacked if within the range of enemies with wall-penetrating abilities.
 Note: Panel selection occurs when entering a stage and when defeating a boss, so if you resume play with existing data, it will reflect the previous state. In such cases, clearing the stage once or restarting the stage will apply the updates.


Balance Adjustments:


 Rear Attack Occupation Adjustment: With the implementation of Plaza panels, the opportunities for rear occupations such as archers and sorcerers to be exposed to attacks have increased. Therefore, overall HP has been increased, and adjustments have been made to defense aspects.
 Druid Adjustments: Previously, the Yiguirro's Branch had a weapon ability that targeted multiple units within the effective range. Now it can heal units around a single unit within the effective range. Additionally, some of the Druid's skills have been adjusted accordingly.
 Adjustments made to the balance of some enemies.
 Timing adjustments for the appearance of strong enemies upon reaching the second tier within a stage.


ADV Illustration Adjustments:


 Adjustments made to Astelia and other ADV illustrations.


Other Minor Bug Fixes and Corrections:


 Adjusted unit skill descriptions to correct inaccuracies.
 Adjusted ADV text.

notes.title: Notice Regarding the Release of Chapter 3
notes.notes:
【Notice Regarding the Release of Chapter 3】

On Saturday, January 27th, we will be implementing a major update that includes Chapter 3. The upcoming patch notes for the post-update changes are as follows.

【Addition of English Version】

Implementation of the English version for the game, excluding the Adventure part. Translating the ADV part is scheduled for a later date due to the complexity of context.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/d1a75cf77ce42d28506e827b780c75e89f416909.png

【Addition of Chapter 3 and New Stages】

Implementation of Chapter 3, featuring new enemies and weapons.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/e1f765ef3a01d1a387f1495f3baf4531725ef728.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/2c9f55938817a8177c65db5864ac64a2a7b2a078.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/5967033e9a5020d9f7318a149d9a560d73a09545.png

【Inheritance and Unlock Elements Addition】

Inherited Units:
Inherited units allow you to carry over units you've raised to the next game, maintaining their skills and job at level 1. Use this as a flexible framework to experiment with various skill combinations, such as maximizing attack power or combining the best features of all jobs.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/dc00ca9310df599f24b24771e8df7c8a95c749ef.png

Inherited Weapons:
Weapons, including their enhancement values, can be carried over to the next game. Train the most powerful weapons with beneficial effects or nurture special weapons dropped by bosses to aid in your strategies. However, it's important to note that inherited weapons cannot be used as enhancement materials for other weapons.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/3bb34b9cadbf1efaabe5f790a8d50c3a73067256.png

Unlock Elements:
The number of inherited units and equipment slots that can be brought into the game will be expanded. Points required for unlocking can be obtained by clearing stages or, in the case of defeat, based on the progress made. Increasing your pledge level will make it easier to accumulate more points, so consider taking on the challenge.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025703/0fda127ca4ba40c83c8348be6e9e6eb82e27d733.png

Additionally, various other updates will be implemented.
